concept.subject: A train of five stunt kites in a pale hazy sky, trailing long ribbon tails that loop around to the left and sweep back along the bottom.
concept.composition: The kite train hangs just below the cannon in the middle; three tails loop up and over to the upper left, down the left side and along the bottom, two of them rising again on the right; the right half of the sky is open.
concept.layout: 83 round pegs and 48 bricks. The kites' leading edges are a short brick spine with a peg on their wingtips; three of the tails' strands are long brick slides looping from the kites over the top left and down the left side, and two more rise on the right as slides back toward the middle. Peg lines follow the tails along the bottom and curl inside their loop; wisps of wind cross the open sky on the right, with a ring by the left wall and a wisp in the upper left.

background.prompt: A photo of a train of five stacked blue delta stunt kites with yellow suns in a plain pale blue sky. The train hangs in the middle, from about 45 to 55 percent of the width and from about three tenths to a half of the height. Their long ribbon tails, dashed in red, yellow and blue, loop up and over to the left, reaching about a sixth of the height at the top and about a seventh of the width at the left, run down the left side and along the bottom at about three quarters to nine tenths of the height, and two of them rise again on the right to about four fifths of the width. The right half of the sky is empty.

picture.title: Multiple colorful kites with long tails flying against a clear sky, showcasing vibrant patterns.
